text:
Rhea (PM): Quick sync to finalize design-partner invite plan for private preview. Target: 9 active orgs, 6-week window.
Samir (Recruiter): Recommend invite 12 to hit 9 active. Mix: 5 startups, 3 midmarket, 1 enterprise, 1 regulated. Short screening call (10 min) to confirm commitment.
Nora (Eng): Tech validation goals: onboarding script runs, rollback policy tested, and per-route cost telemetry in place. Need staggered start to avoid autoscale storms.
Ethan (Research): Success criteria proposal: primary = onboarding completion within 72h for 70% of cohort; secondary = weekly qualitative sentiment >= 3/5; ops incidents <= 1 per org.
Clara (Design): Onboarding deliverables: 30-min kickoff, a one-pager checklist, and a prefilled repo with sample configs. Weekly 3-question pulse + one mid-pilot interview.
Samir (Recruiter): Screening form snippet:
```
Company stage: [Seed/Series A/Mid/Enterprise]
Primary use-case: [chat/embeddings/search/other]
Expected peak qps: [<10/10-100/>100]
Can join weekly 30m syncs? [yes/no]
Consent to debug telemetry? [yes/no]
```
Nora (Eng): Define onboarding completion = accept -> first successful inference that exercises routing + no errors. We'll log timestamp for metric.
Ethan (Research): Metric weights suggestion: onboarding 50%, reliability 30%, qualitative 20%. Agree?
Rhea (PM): Agreed. Launch gates: security checklist signed, eval prompts uploaded, dashboard created. Otherwise move to waitlist.
Samir (Recruiter): Timeline: outreach next Mon, screening calls Mon-Wed, rolling onboard starting two weeks after outreach.
scheduler-bot: Reminder: create calendar slots for onboarding calls.
Rhea (PM): Action items: Samir build shortlist + Typeform, Nora prepare rollout playbook, Clara draft checklist, Ethan build pulse survey. Reconvene Fri 9am to review shortlist.
